expectations.description: The top music status bar element (#music-status) must update from 'Silent' to display the active playlist name.
expectations.criteria: Visually inspect the #music-status text in the top header bar of the video. The text must change from '🎵 Silent' to display an active playlist name (e.g. '🎵 default' or '🎵 desert adventure').
expectations.success_condition: The top header status bar displays the active playlist name on screen.

expectations.description: Background music audio track must be audible during playback.
expectations.criteria: Listen to the audio track of the video. Background music corresponding to the active playlist must be clearly audible.
expectations.success_condition: Background music track is audible in the video.

expectations.description: Background music must start with a smooth volume fade-in transition rather than an abrupt volume jump.
expectations.criteria: Evaluate the volume transition when background music begins playing. The music volume should progressively swell from silence to full volume over approximately 1.5 to 2 seconds.
expectations.success_condition: Music playback exhibits a smooth volume fade-in transition at start.
